errors.text_span: 表明模型在训练过程中未出现明显过拟合
errors.evidence: This part of the description provides an interpretation of the model's performance (i.e., 'did not show significant overfitting'), which is not explicitly stated in the chart. The description should focus only on what is visually represented.

errors.text_span: 训练准确率在第15轮后趋于平稳
